title: A Good Name
traveler_why: Tonight is a story about telling the truth when nobody saw and nobody would have known, and Beau the Brave is the Traveler who takes the brave breath and says it out loud anyway.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because he chooses to be honest, even when it’s hard. In Beau’s world today: Beau accidentally broke a little toy while playing. No one saw. He could have stayed quiet — but his tummy felt yucky. So he took a brave breath and told the truth: “I broke it, and I’m sorry.” His mom hugged him and said, “Thank you for being honest.” Just like Solomon said a good name is a treasure, Beau built his good name by telling the truth.
